title: UI风格#44 - Minimal Zen Garden (极简枯山水)
description: 创建第44种UI风格：极简枯山水风格 - 日式庭院、白砂青石、静谧空间。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planAR.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimal Zen Garden style When color palette Then features white sand, moss green, stone gray, bamboo
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: #F5F5F5 (白砂), #4A5D23 (苔绿), #696969 (石灰), #8B7355 (竹色), #FAFAFA (近白)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimal Zen Garden style When typography Then uses zen calligraphy: Noto Serif JP, Shippori Mincho, or Zen Antique
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Zen Antique (标题), Noto Serif JP (正文)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimal Zen Garden style When layout Then rake patterns, stone placement, moss patches, bamboo frames
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: raked sand background (CSS repeating gradient), 3 stone decorations, bamboo divider

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimal Zen Garden style When UI elements Then sand ripples, stone textures, moss growth
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: stone shapes with shadows, subtle hover transforms, zen input with bottom border

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimal Zen Garden UI When functional Then includes sand chat, stone agents, garden stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: contemplate chat, 4 agents (Stone/Moss/Bamboo/Sand) with garden metrics

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimal Zen Garden UI When copy Then uses japanese zen: 'Karesansui', 'Rake', 'Stone', 'Moss'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'KARESANUI.', button 'RAKE', status 'Present'/'Growing'/'Still', agent names with kanji (石/苔/竹/砂)
